doc: Searches a byte table (base D_80085FA4[0], length D_800869B0[0]) starting at byte index `a0`, looking for a run of 4 bytes matching the fixed pattern D_80033104. Returns (match index + 4) on success, or -1 if the search runs off the end of the table without finding a match. Byte-identical twin of func_80058850 (same shape, different compare-pattern global).

globals.name: D_80085FA4
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80085FA4[4]; /* [0] = base address of a byte table; forced hi/lo access via size>8; consistent with func_80058850/func_80058940/func_8005AE90 etc. */

globals.name: D_800869B0
globals.decl: extern s32 D_800869B0[4]; /* [0] = table length/bound compared unsigned against running index; forced hi/lo access via size>8 */

globals.name: D_80033104
globals.decl: extern s8 D_80033104[]; /* fixed 4-byte compare pattern, analogous to D_800330FC used by sibling func_80058850 */

calls: func_80058800(s8 *a0, s8 *a1, s32 a2) -- memcmp-like byte comparison helper (already matched)
